subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted structured context, also made available to plugin hooks, or persisted as session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is source-clear, but ctwaClid is ad attribution data and the issue asks for prompt/session visibility, so automation should not choose the exposure and retention boundary.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted context
options.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

options.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
options.body: Define a typed WhatsApp attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without putting the identifier into every agent prompt.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only after maintainers approve a retention, redaction, and access policy.

recommendation.title: Per-turn untrusted context
recommendation.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across WhatsApp inbound extraction, prompt metadata boundaries, and session metadata persistence.
